svg.title: Structured Transformer Actor: implemented spatial-temporal policy
svg.desc: Five raw frames enter a shared spatial encoder and two causal temporal blocks. Four actuator queries and one state query read temporal memory. Current raw features and estimated state feed shared leg and wheel heads. Only training uses the independent critic and auxiliary prediction head.
svg.text: 单一运动控制策略 · 策略100 Hz / 物理200 Hz · 5帧含当前，跨度40 ms
